title: SDK & API launch orchestration: canonical release notes, sample matrix, and cross-team go-to-market
creator: Asha Patil
description:
Goal: Coordinate a single canonical launch for the new SDK & API surface (function-calling, structured output, server-side streaming) that includes synchronized release notes, a comprehensive sample matrix across languages, and a cross-team go-to-market checklist. This ticket owns orchestration, gating, and final sign-offs for docs, SDKs, console UI notes, and customer communications.

Scope:
- Release notes canonicalization and final HTML/Markdown artifact for website and in-console changelog.
- Sample matrix covering JS, Python, Go, and Java SDKs plus raw REST examples for each feature: function-calling, structured JSON output, and streaming.
- Coordinate with Eng (runtime & SDK owners), Docs (samples + migration guides), DevRel (tutorials + blog), Marketing (announce cadence), and Support (KB updates & FAQs).
- Ensure release is covered in Console release banner, API changelog, SDK package release notes, and Redwood status page notes if applicable.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical release-notes document published to Confluence + converted to website Markdown and attached to the product release PR
All SDK repos (js, python, go, java) have sample PRs merged that exercise function-calling, structured output, and streaming with CI passing
Docs team sign-off on migration guide for structured output and streaming semantics
DevRel has at least two tutorial drafts (one blog, one video script) assigned
Support has KB article drafts and 5 common troubleshooting Q&A entries
tasks: Draft canonical release notes (PM) and circulate to stakeholders
Create sample matrix spreadsheet mapping features to sample repos and owners
Open PR templates for SDKs with example calls and test harness
Finalize in-console changelog blurb with Console PM
Prepare email/social draft for marketing and partner channels
Coordinate canary schedule and rollback playbook with Runtime SRE
notes: This ticket consolidates feedback from early beta customers (internal & external). We are standardizing example outputs for structured JSON to avoid per-language divergence. Streaming semantics require small API phrasing changes — docs need exact wire examples. Use the sample matrix to ensure parity.
updates: 2026-02-12: Initial draft of canonical release notes published; asked Docs to validate structured output examples.
2026-02-15: SDK PRs opened for JS & Python (see samples_repo_prs). CI failing on streaming tests — assigned to Kenji Watanabe.
2026-02-18: SRE flagged a KV-cache interaction risk during high-concurrency streaming; added to runtime mitigation checklist and scheduled canary window.
2026-02-22: Docs reviewers requested explicit migration notes for customers currently using free-text outputs — Marina Lopez to draft by 2026-02-25.
2026-02-25: Marketing provided signal on launch date preference: 2026-03-09 or 2026-03-16. Holding until SDK stability confirmed.
2026-02-28: SDK Go streaming PR flake fixed; JS streaming edge-case remains (race when closing connection). Jonah to prioritize with Kenji.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Streaming API backpressure / concurrency could cause elevated latency under canary. Mitigation: SRE to run 72-hour canary at reduced traffic with fallback to non-streaming endpoint.
Risk: Inconsistent structured output across SDKs. Mitigation: Use a canonical JSON schema in docs and a test harness that verifies parity across languages.
Risk: Release note churn causing mismatched client expectations. Mitigation: Lock release-notes 48 hours before public announcement and keep a short change log for post-release patches.
communication_plan: Internal: All-hands launch channel in #launches, and a launch readout doc with decision log
External: Blog post + announcement email + SDK package release notes; staggered social posts coordinated with Marketing
Support: KB & canned responses published 24 hours before external announcement
followups: Post-launch: 2-week bug triage rhythm and telemetry dashboard to track adoption and error rates
Post-launch: Add a 'migration helper' script to samples repo to convert dominant free-text prompts to structured-output patterns
